sheets.label: Methodology
sheets.title: Assumptions, definitions & how to use this workbook
sheets.subtitle: TEST S'26 · feedback analysis

items.definition: feedback.xlsx (60 rows). — see the dashboard sheets for the numbers.
Summary rows without a timestamp and repeat submissions (same e-mail; the latest one is kept) are removed before any count.
60 unique respondents after de-duplication ≈ 10% of registrants.
Overall organization, Coffee break
Organizer support, Networking quality, Telegram chat
Mean divided by the scale maximum and multiplied by 10, so 1–5 and 1–10 questions can be compared.
Top-box = rating ≥ 90% of the scale maximum; Low = rating ≤ 60% of the scale maximum; Mid = everything in between.
Share of promoters (9–10) minus share of detractors (≤ 6) on 'Overall organization', in points from −100 to +100.
Average of all ratings after normalising each to /10, computed per respondent and then averaged.
Every open answer was read and hand-coded into themes; one answer can carry several themes, so mentions can add up to more than the number of respondents.
Mentions divided by the number of respondents (not by the number of mentions).
Respondents are usually the most engaged attendees, so scores are likely higher than the average participant's experience.
Segment means with a small n move a lot with one answer — read them as direction, not as proof.
